title: Map real policy layers into the capability contract (VC-201-071)
goal: VC-201-071 refuted: evaluate() consumes caller-fabricated LayerDecision values — nothing derives them from MacPolicy/CapabilityToken or the daemon CapabilityPolicy, so the 'unified' contract is never applied; a single invented Allow layer (or the omission of the real mac layer) permits; EntryPoint is ignored (`let _ = entry`). Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_071_mastery.rs.
